title: astragalus longidentatus
intro: Astragalus longidentatus, commonly known as Chinese milk vetch, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of China. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus longidentatus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
